name: Particle Text Form
description: Thousands of particles spiral in from a wide ring and assemble the headline in a left-to-right wave, resolve into crisp glowing gradient type, then scatter upward.
move: Thousands of particles spiral in from a wide ring and assemble the headline in a left-to-right wave, resolve into crisp glowing gradient type, then scatter upward.
how: The headline is rasterised offscreen and sampled every 3px into ~4k targets. Each particle eases in with ease-out quint while its offset rotates (a spiral), delayed by x position plus seeded scatter, drawn additively. Crisp fillText with a gradient and glow crossfades in once particles land, and back out before they disperse.
adapt: Change TEXT and FONT; keep sample step ≥3px for performance. Placeholder product names and copy are generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Pure draw(t): mount the markup in the shot and call draw from the film's frame hook with shot-local time; wait for fonts before sampling or measuring.
caveats: Original implementation; no third-party UI kit, product or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
